Class Card

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
DamageCard, ProgrammingCard, UpgradeCard
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Cloneable
Abstract base class for all card types in the SEP25 game.

A Card has a textual description and a Card.CardType, and defines an abstract execute(Robot, Player) method to apply its effect during gameplay. Subclasses must implement cloning to allow safe copying.

    • execute

      public abstract void execute(Robot robot, Player player)
      Executes the effect of this card on the specified robot and player.

      Concrete subclasses should implement this to apply their unique behavior during the register or game phases.

      Parameters:
      robot - the Robot instance on which to apply the card
      player - the Player who controls the robot
